ModMetaData.name: Find / Trade - 繁體中文翻譯
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) translation for Find / Trade by Meme Goddess and the TD Find Lib - Continued library it is built on.
Translates the trade rules, letters, settings and the Find / Trade tab, plus the whole Find window: search library, all filter names and options, including the Royalty, Ideology, Biotech and Odyssey filters (loaded only when that expansion is active). Terms follow the vanilla Traditional Chinese translation.
Load after Find / Trade. Safe to add to or remove from an existing save. A few labels are hardcoded in Find / Trade and stay in English.
